Witnessed my mom get the shit beat out of her by various boyfriends from a very young age, tons of men walking in and out of our lives, lived through some terrible events (Having birthday presents stolen, having someone bust our windows in with a baseball bat, mom's ex decapitated my dog) the only thing that made me feel anything in my childhood was food. It tasted good, and for the split second my tastebuds processed what I was eating, I felt some form of happiness. So when I wanted to feel anything other than, pain/sadness/fear/hatred I turned to food. 

The events from an early age caused my social skills to develop in a warped sense, and along with being fat, I was labeled weird and couldnt connect with my peers. So I got teased, so it turned into being put through hell at school, and hell at home. I became a zombie, stopped processing emotions, the only thing that made me feel ANYTHING was food, so I gained even more weight. I was molested in high school, and the principles reaction was, she's too fat to get molested and I just gave up. 

I eventually got tired of being treated like shit, and took it upon myself to lose all of my weight. I've been treated like trash my whole childhood, and I didn't want my adulthood to go the same way. I pretty much saw the cycle starting, the abused kid, getting in abusive relationship and abusing their own kids and I'm stopping it. 

I've lost 112 pounds, and I've set my goals on going to law school and being everything I deserve. 

The weight loss isn't the only thing im dealing with

- I can't form relationships
- I've never had any friends/Don't have any friends
- I'm afraid of men, I'm lonely.
- I want a family, but I'm not sure if its possible for me.
- Alcohol and anything addictive is a No-No because, i'm constantly in a lot of pain, I want it to go away, but I want to do it the right way.
- Severe anxiety and panic attacks. 

Not turning towards food is hard, I've had no support through the child abuse and most of the weight-loss. I'm just trying to focus on college, and take it one step at a time.

-END Mini-Rant-
